WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Encounter for symptom like fever') AS ref_vec_0,

EncounterMatches AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.PATIENT, e.DATE, e.DESCRIPTION, distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM encounters e
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT em.ID
FROM EncounterMatches em
JOIN patients p ON toString(em.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
WHERE p.gender = 'Female' AND p.race = 'Asian'
ORDER BY em.distance
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic bronchitis') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bronchodilator') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

m_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM medications

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

ConditionMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        c.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
        c.DESCRIPTION AS condition_description,
        c.distance AS condition_distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
      ORDER BY 
        c.distance AS distance
),

MedicationMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
        m.DESCRIPTION AS medication_description,
        m.distance AS medication_distance
      FROM m_filtered AS m
      ORDER BY 
        m.distance AS distance
)

SELECT 
  e.PATIENT AS PATIENT
FROM 
  encounters e
JOIN 
  ConditionMatches cm ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(cm.PATIENT)
JOIN 
  MedicationMatches mm ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(mm.PATIENT)
WHERE 
  e.DATE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
LIMIT 1;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic respiratory disorder') AS ref_vec_0,

ConditionMatches AS (
    SELECT c.PATIENT, c.ENCOUNTER, distance(c.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM conditions AS c
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

PatientInfo AS (
    SELECT pm.patient, pm.first, pm.last, cm.ENCOUNTER
      FROM patients pm
      JOIN ConditionMatches cm ON toString(pm.patient) = toString(cm.PATIENT)
),

EncounterDetails AS (
    SELECT ed.ID AS encounter_id, ed.DATE AS encounter_date, cm.distance
      FROM encounters ed
      JOIN ConditionMatches cm ON toString(ed.ID) = toString(cm.ENCOUNTER)
      ORDER BY cm.distance
)

SELECT pi.first || ' ' || pi.last AS full_name, ed.encounter_date
FROM PatientInfo pi
JOIN EncounterDetails ed ON toString(pi.ENCOUNTER) = toString(ed.encounter_id)
ORDER BY ed.distance
LIMIT 10;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Paracetamol for pain relief') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic headache condition') AS ref_vec_1,

m_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM medications

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

MedicationMatch AS (
    SELECT 
            m.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
            m.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, 
            m.distance AS distance
        FROM m_filtered AS m
),

ConditionMatch AS (
    SELECT 
            c.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
            c.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION
        FROM c_filtered AS c
),

JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
            mm.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
            cm.DESCRIPTION AS Condition_Description, 
            mm.DESCRIPTION AS Medication_Description
        FROM 
            MedicationMatch mm
        JOIN 
            ConditionMatch cm ON toString(mm.PATIENT) = toString(cm.PATIENT)
)

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT jd.PATIENT) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients)) * 100 AS Prevalence_Percentage
FROM 
    JoinedData jd;

external_knowledge: In vector operations, the `MATCH` operator is used to perform an approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search, identifying items whose vector embeddings closely align with a specified query vector. The `lembed()` function generates vector embeddings based on input phrases or concepts, in this case, "Viral Infection Example". The ANN search compares these embeddings using Euclidean distance (L2 norm), where smaller distances indicate higher similarity. The LIMIT clause specifies the number of results to return, here capped at five. Additionally, "Viral Infection" refers to diseases caused by viruses, characterized by high transmissibility and diverse symptoms.

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Comprehensive diabetes care plan') AS ref_vec_0,

patient_info AS (
    SELECT 
            patient, 
            first, 
            last, 
            gender, 
            ethnicity
        FROM 
            patients
        WHERE 
            gender = 'Female' AND
            ethnicity = 'Hispanic or Latino'
)

SELECT 
    cp.ID AS ID, 
    cp.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, 
    p.first AS first, 
    p.last AS last, 
    distance(cp.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
FROM 
    careplans AS cp
JOIN 
    patient_info AS p ON toString(cp.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bacterial Sinusitis Condition') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic bronchitis disorder') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance

),

cp_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM careplans

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT p.birthplace
FROM patients p
JOIN c_filtered AS c ON toString(p.patient) = toString(c.PATIENT)
JOIN cp_filtered AS cp ON toString(p.patient) = toString(cp.PATIENT);

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic disease management plan focusing on diabetes control') AS ref_vec_0,

TopCarePlans AS (
    SELECT 
            ID, 
            PATIENT, 
            distance(careplans.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance 
        FROM 
            careplans
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

MedicationRecords AS (
    SELECT 
            PATIENT, 
            DESCRIPTION 
        FROM 
            medications 
        WHERE 
            PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM TopCarePlans)
)

SELECT 
    m.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION
FROM 
    MedicationRecords m
JOIN 
    TopCarePlans t ON toString(m.PATIENT) = toString(t.PATIENT)
ORDER BY 
    t.distance;
question: In the vast forest of patient care, unveil the medication pathways prescribed to the five patients walking the focused path of chronic disease management, specifically taming the diabetes beast.
external_knowledge: The `MATCH` operator in SQLite's vector extension performs an approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search to find entries most similar to a specified vector representation. The `lembed()` function generates a vector embedding for a provided text, and the `k = 5` condition specifies that only the top 5 closest matches should be returned. In vector searches, the similarity is determined by distance (most commonly, Euclidean distance), where a smaller distance indicates higher similarity. In this context, a "Chronic disease management plan focusing on diabetes control" is the vector target, seeking care plans aligned with managing diabetes effectively.

AlivePatients AS (
    SELECT patient, gender, birthplace
      FROM patients
      WHERE deathdate IS NULL
        AND birthplace LIKE '%Springfield%'
)

FROM procedures p
JOIN AlivePatients ap ON toString(p.PATIENT) = toString(ap.patient)
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Routine check-up visit for hypertension') AS ref_vec_0,

EncounterMatches AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.DATE, e.PATIENT, e.DESCRIPTION, distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM encounters AS e
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

ConditionPrevalence AS (
    SELECT c.PATIENT, c.ENCOUNTER, c.CODE, c.DESCRIPTION
      FROM conditions AS c
      JOIN all_prevalences AS p ON toString(c.CODE) = toString(p.ITEM) 
      WHERE p.POPULATION_TYPE = 'Hypertension Patients'
      AND p.PREVALENCE_PERCENTAGE > 5
),

PatientInfo AS (
    SELECT p.patient, p.first, p.last, p.race, p.ethnicity, p.gender
      FROM patients AS p
      WHERE p.race = 'White' AND p.ethnicity = 'Not Hispanic or Latino'
)

SELECT em.ID AS EncounterID, em.DATE AS EncounterDate, em.DESCRIPTION AS EncounterDescription, 
       cp.CODE AS ConditionCode, cp.DESCRIPTION AS ConditionDescription, 
       pi.first AS FirstName, pi.last AS LastName, pi.race, pi.ethnicity, pi.gender, em.distance
FROM EncounterMatches AS em
JOIN ConditionPrevalence AS cp ON toString(em.PATIENT) = toString(cp.PATIENT)
JOIN PatientInfo AS pi ON toString(em.PATIENT) = toString(pi.patient)
ORDER BY em.distance
LIMIT 5;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Asthma or related respiratory condition') AS ref_vec_0,

similar_conditions AS (
    SELECT
        c.PATIENT AS PATIENT,
        c.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        distance(c.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM
        conditions c
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

encounter_info AS (
    SELECT
        e.PATIENT AS PATIENT,
        e.DATE AS DATE,
        e.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION
      FROM
        encounters e
      WHERE
        e.DATE > '2023-01-01'
)

SELECT
  p.first || ' ' || p.last AS patient_name
FROM
  patients p
JOIN
  similar_conditions sc ON toString(p.patient) = toString(sc.PATIENT)
JOIN
  encounter_info ei ON toString(p.patient) = toString(ei.PATIENT)
WHERE
  p.gender = 'Female'
  AND ei.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%emergency%'
LIMIT 10;

PatientDetails AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient AS patient,
        p.first AS first,
        p.last AS last,
        p.gender AS gender,
        p.birthdate AS birthdate
      FROM
        patients p
      WHERE
        p.gender = 'Female'
)

SELECT
  e.DESCRIPTION, distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
FROM
  encounters e
JOIN
  PatientDetails pd ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(pd.patient)
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Urinary tract infection') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Regular health examination') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

e_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT c.PATIENT
FROM c_filtered AS c
JOIN e_filtered AS e ON toString(c.ENCOUNTER) = toString(e.ID)
ORDER BY c.distance, e.distance;

    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Acute respiratory distress') AS ref_vec_0,

PatientDemographics AS (
    SELECT patient
        FROM patients
        WHERE gender = 'Female' AND race = 'Asian'

ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

external_knowledge: The query leverages vector search, specifically approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search, which identifies items most semantically similar to a given concept—in this case, "Acute respiratory distress." The `MATCH` operator performs this search, using the embeddings from `lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', ...)`, a pre-trained language model. The parameter `k=5` specifies that the search will return the top 5 conditions that are most similar to the input concept. Similarity is calculated using Euclidean distance, where lesser distance indicates higher similarity.

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Allergy to dairy product') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Measurement of respiratory function (procedure)') AS ref_vec_1,

allergies_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM allergies

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

procedures_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM procedures

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

SimilarAllergies AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, distance 
        FROM allergies_filtered AS allergies
),

SimilarProcedures AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, distance 
        FROM procedures_filtered AS procedures
),

PatientConditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.PATIENT, ap.PREVALENCE_RATE
        FROM conditions c
        JOIN SimilarAllergies sa ON toString(c.PATIENT) = toString(sa.PATIENT)
        JOIN SimilarProcedures sp ON toString(c.PATIENT) = toString(sp.PATIENT)
        JOIN all_prevalences ap ON toString(c.DESCRIPTION) = toString(ap.ITEM)
)

SELECT AVG(PREVALENCE_RATE) AS average_prevalence_rate
FROM PatientConditions;

    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bladder infection') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Urinary tract infection') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

e_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

SimilarConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        c.PATIENT AS PATIENT,
        c.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        c.distance as condition_distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
)

SELECT 
  p.first || ' ' || p.last AS full_name,
  e.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
  e.distance as encounter_distance
FROM 
  SimilarConditions sc
JOIN 
  patients p ON toString(sc.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
JOIN e_filtered AS e ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
ORDER BY 
  sc.condition_distance, e.distance;

The parameter `k=N` specifies how many of these similar items should be retrieved. In this context, semantic embeddings are used to identify patients with conditions and encounters similar to specific medical conditions. The similarity is determined by the Euclidean distance between vector representations, with smaller distances indicating higher similarity.

    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Routine checkup') AS ref_vec_1,

PatientConditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.PATIENT
        FROM conditions c
        WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Cystitis'
),

MedicationEncounters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.PATIENT, m.ENCOUNTER
        FROM medications m
        INNER JOIN PatientConditions pc ON toString(pc.PATIENT) = toString(m.PATIENT)
        WHERE m.DESCRIPTION = 'Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG'
),

SimilarEncounters AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.PATIENT, e.DESCRIPTION, e.distance
        FROM e_filtered AS e
        INNER JOIN MedicationEncounters me ON toString(me.ENCOUNTER) = toString(e.ID)
),

PatientProcedures AS (
    SELECT p.DATE, p.PATIENT, p.DESCRIPTION, p.distance
        FROM p_filtered AS p
        INNER JOIN SimilarEncounters se ON toString(se.PATIENT) = toString(p.PATIENT)
)

SELECT sp.DESCRIPTION
FROM PatientProcedures sp
ORDER BY sp.distance
LIMIT 1;

The `MATCH lembed` function uses a model named "all-MiniLM-L6-v2" to calculate embeddings, which are multi-dimensional representations of the text data. These embeddings allow the system to measure semantic similarity instead of just textual match, significantly enhancing the search to capture context and meaning. The "k = 3" indicates the retrieval of the top three most similar items based on Euclidean distance, where a smaller distance indicates higher similarity. This approach enables the database to find records that resonate in theme and context with specified medical conditions and procedures, even if the text does not match exactly.

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease') AS ref_vec_0

SELECT distance(c.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
FROM conditions c
JOIN all_prevalences ap ON toString(ap.ITEM) = toString(c.DESCRIPTION)
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;
question: In the realm where ailments whisper their tales, which condition stands closest at the doorstep of "Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease," as judged by the smallest leap of distance in understanding?
external_knowledge: In vector search operations within databases like SQLite with the `sqlite-vec` extension, the `MATCH` keyword is used to perform an approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search. This is designed to find entries within a database that are most similar to a given input vector, based on learned embeddings. The `lembed()` function generates a vector representation of the input phrase, and the search returns the top `k` results that are most similar to this vector. The `distance` column measures how similar each result is to the input; a smaller distance indicates a higher similarity. Thus, in the context of diseases or conditions, a smaller distance suggests a condition that shares closer characteristics or semantics with the specified disease.

The results are sorted by their Euclidean distance, with smaller distances indicating higher similarity.

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Routine check-up for respiratory issues') AS ref_vec_0,

EncounterCTE AS (
    SELECT
        e.ID AS ID,
        e.DATE AS DATE,
        e.PATIENT AS PATIENT,
        e.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM
        encounters e
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
)

SELECT
  ec.ID AS EncounterID,
  p.first || ' ' || p.last AS PatientName,
  ec.DESCRIPTION AS EncounterDescription
FROM
  EncounterCTE ec
JOIN
  patients p ON toString(ec.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
ORDER BY
  ec.distance AS distance
LIMIT 5;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic respiratory conditions') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Respiratory therapy') AS ref_vec_1,

conditions_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

procedures_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM procedures

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

ConditionMatches AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, distance AS condition_distance
      FROM conditions_filtered AS conditions
),

ProcedureMatches AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, distance AS procedure_distance
      FROM procedures_filtered AS procedures
)

SELECT c.PATIENT
FROM ConditionMatches c
JOIN ProcedureMatches p ON toString(c.PATIENT) = toString(p.PATIENT)
ORDER BY c.condition_distance + p.procedure_distance
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Outpatient visit for respiratory issues') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Respiratory disorder') AS ref_vec_1,

e_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

RelevantEncounters AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.DATE, e.PATIENT, e.DESCRIPTION, e.distance
      FROM e_filtered AS e
),

RelevantConditions AS (
    SELECT c.START, c.STOP, c.PATIENT, c.DESCRIPTION, c.distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
)

SELECT p.first, p.last, p.birthdate
FROM patients p
JOIN RelevantEncounters re ON toString(p.patient) = toString(re.PATIENT)
JOIN RelevantConditions rc ON toString(p.patient) = toString(rc.PATIENT)
ORDER BY re.distance, rc.distance
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Routine Checkup') AS ref_vec_0,

EncounterAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        e.ID AS encounter_id, 
        e.DATE AS encounter_date,
        e.PATIENT AS patient_id, 
        e.DESCRIPTION AS encounter_description,
        e.REASONDESCRIPTION AS reason_description,
        distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS description_distance
      FROM 
        encounters e
    ORDER BY description_distance
    LIMIT 10
),

PatientInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        p.patient AS patient_id,
        p.first AS first_name,
        p.last AS last_name,
        p.race AS race,
        p.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
        p.gender AS gender,
        p.birthdate AS birth_date
      FROM 
        patients p
),

EncounterDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ea.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
        pi.first_name || ' ' || pi.last_name AS full_name,
        pi.birth_date AS birth_date,
        pi.race AS race,
        pi.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
        pi.gender AS gender,
        ea.encounter_date AS encounter_date,
        ea.encounter_description AS encounter_description,
        ea.reason_description AS reason_description,
        ea.description_distance AS description_distance
      FROM 
        EncounterAnalysis ea
      JOIN 
        PatientInfo pi ON toString(ea.patient_id) = toString(pi.patient_id)
)

SELECT 
  ed.encounter_id AS encounter_id
FROM 
  EncounterDetails ed
ORDER BY 
  ed.description_distance AS description_distance
LIMIT 5;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Advice to limit physical activity') AS ref_vec_0,

CarePlanExerciseCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.ID AS CarePlanID,
        cp.PATIENT AS PatientID,
        cp.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        distance(cp.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM careplans cp
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

PatientInfoCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        p.patient AS PatientID,
        p.first AS FirstName,
        p.last AS LastName,
        p.birthdate AS BirthDate
      FROM patients p
)

SELECT 
  pi.FirstName AS FirstName,
  pi.LastName AS LastName
FROM CarePlanExerciseCTE cpe
JOIN PatientInfoCTE pi ON toString(cpe.PatientID) = toString(pi.PatientID)
ORDER BY cpe.distance
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic bronchitis') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Albuterol') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

m_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM medications

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

similar_conditions AS (
    SELECT c.PATIENT, c.CODE, c.START, c.STOP, c.DESCRIPTION, c.distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
),

similar_medications AS (
    SELECT m.PATIENT, m.CODE, m.START, m.STOP, m.DESCRIPTION, m.REASONDESCRIPTION, m.distance
      FROM m_filtered AS m
),

conditions_medications AS (
    SELECT sc.PATIENT, sc.CODE AS condition_code, sc.DESCRIPTION AS condition_description,
             sm.CODE AS medication_code, sm.DESCRIPTION AS medication_description,
             sm.REASONDESCRIPTION AS REASONDESCRIPTION
      FROM similar_conditions AS sc
      JOIN similar_medications AS sm ON toString(sc.PATIENT) = toString(sm.PATIENT)
),

prevalence_analysis AS (
    SELECT cm.condition_code, cm.condition_description,
             cm.medication_code, cm.medication_description,
             ap.PREVALENCE_PERCENTAGE AS PREVALENCE_PERCENTAGE
      FROM conditions_medications AS cm
      LEFT JOIN all_prevalences AS ap ON toString(cm.condition_code) = toString(ap.ITEM)
      WHERE ap.POPULATION_TYPE = 'GENERAL'
)

SELECT condition_code
FROM prevalence_analysis
ORDER BY prevalence_analysis.PREVALENCE_PERCENTAGE DESC
LIMIT 1;

The vector model 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2' converts textual data into a multi-dimensional vector space, allowing for comparisons based on Euclidean distance. The closer two vector representations are, the more semantically similar they are considered. The "LIMIT 1" clause returns the single most similar description to the provided phrase. In this context, the phrase "Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with acute exacerbation" describes a serious lung condition, where "acute exacerbation" refers to a sudden worsening of symptoms.

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Symptom: headache and dizziness') AS ref_vec_0,

RelevantPatients AS (
    SELECT patient, first, last
      FROM patients
      WHERE gender = 'Female'
)

SELECT rp.first || ' ' || rp.last AS patient_name, distance(e.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
FROM RelevantPatients rp
JOIN encounters e ON toString(rp.patient) = toString(e.PATIENT)
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 5;

The Euclidean distance (L2 norm) is used to measure similarity, where a smaller distance indicates a closer match to the query vector. This operation is helpful in identifying encounters that semantically match the concept of specific symptoms, rather than relying on exact keyword matches.

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bronchitis-related symptoms') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

e_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),

ConditionCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        c.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
        c.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION
      FROM c_filtered AS c
)

SELECT 
  e.ID AS ID, 
  e.REASONDESCRIPTION AS REASONDESCRIPTION
FROM 
  ConditionCTE AS cc
JOIN e_filtered AS e ON toString(cc.PATIENT) = toString(e.PATIENT)
ORDER BY 
  e.distance AS distance
LIMIT 2;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bronchitis symptoms') AS ref_vec_0,

RecentEncounters AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, DATE
      FROM encounters
      WHERE DATE > '2023-01-01'
),

SimilarConditions AS (
    SELECT c.PATIENT, c.DESCRIPTION, distance(c.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM conditions AS c
      JOIN RecentEncounters AS re ON toString(c.PATIENT) = toString(re.PATIENT)
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT sc.PATIENT
FROM SimilarConditions AS sc
WHERE sc.distance < 0.5
ORDER BY sc.distance
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic respiratory condition') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Respiratory therapy') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

cp_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM careplans

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

ConditionMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        c.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
        c.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, 
        c.distance AS condition_distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
),

CareplanMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.PATIENT AS PATIENT, 
        cp.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, 
        cp.distance AS careplan_distance
      FROM cp_filtered AS cp
)

SELECT 
  p.first || ' ' || p.last AS patient_name
FROM 
  ConditionMatches cm
JOIN 
  CareplanMatches cpm ON toString(cm.PATIENT) = toString(cpm.PATIENT)
JOIN 
  patients p ON toString(cm.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
WHERE 
  cm.condition_distance < 0.5 
  AND cpm.careplan_distance < 0.5
ORDER BY 
  cm.condition_distance + cpm.careplan_distance
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Respiratory therapy') AS ref_vec_1,

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),

cp_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM careplans

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
),

RelevantConditions AS (
    SELECT c.PATIENT, c.DESCRIPTION, c.distance
      FROM c_filtered AS c
),

PatientDemographics AS (
    SELECT p.patient, p.first, p.last
      FROM patients p
      WHERE p.race = 'White' AND p.ethnicity = 'Non-Hispanic'
)

SELECT rc.DESCRIPTION AS ConditionDescription, cp.DESCRIPTION AS CarePlanDescription
FROM RelevantConditions rc
JOIN cp_filtered AS cp ON toString(rc.PATIENT) = toString(cp.PATIENT)
JOIN PatientDemographics pd ON toString(rc.PATIENT) = toString(pd.patient)
ORDER BY cp.distance
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM allergies

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

PatientEncounters AS (
    SELECT 
        e.ID AS encounter_id,
        p.patient AS patient,
        e.DATE AS DATE,
        e.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        e.REASONDESCRIPTION AS REASONDESCRIPTION,
        e.distance AS distance
      FROM e_filtered AS e
      JOIN 
        patients p ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(p.patient)
      ORDER BY 
        e.distance AS distance
),

AllergyEncounters AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ENCOUNTER AS encounter_id,
        a.PATIENT AS PATIENT,
        a.START AS START,
        a.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
        a.distance AS distance
      FROM a_filtered AS a
      ORDER BY 
        a.distance AS distance
)

SELECT 
  pe.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
  ae.START AS START
FROM 
  PatientEncounters pe
JOIN 
  AllergyEncounters ae ON toString(pe.encounter_id) = toString(ae.encounter_id)
WHERE 
  pe.DATE > '2022-01-01'
LIMIT 10;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Check-up for flu-like symptoms') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Plan for treating acute respiratory conditions') AS ref_vec_1,

encounters_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM careplans

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

RecentEncounters AS (
    SELECT ID, PATIENT, REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding
      FROM encounters_filtered AS encounters
)

SELECT DISTINCT c.DESCRIPTION
FROM c_filtered AS c
JOIN RecentEncounters AS e ON toString(c.PATIENT) = toString(e.PATIENT)
ORDER BY c.distance;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Respiratory therapy session') AS ref_vec_0,

EncounterCTE AS (
    SELECT ID, DESCRIPTION, distance(encounters.DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
      FROM encounters
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 3
)

SELECT e.ID, p.first
FROM EncounterCTE e
JOIN patients p ON toString(e.ID) = toString(p.patient)
ORDER BY e.distance
LIMIT 5;

sql:
WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Allergy to pollen') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Asthma management plan') AS ref_vec_1,

a_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM allergies

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

c_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM careplans

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT 
  p.patient AS patient_id, 
  a.DESCRIPTION AS allergy_description, 
  c.DESCRIPTION AS careplan_description, 
  op.VALUE AS observation_value
FROM patients p
JOIN a_filtered AS a ON toString(p.patient) = toString(a.PATIENT)
JOIN c_filtered AS c ON toString(p.patient) = toString(c.PATIENT)
JOIN observations op ON toString(p.patient) = toString(op.PATIENT)
JOIN all_prevalences ap ON toString(a.CODE) = toString(ap.ITEM)
 WHERE ap.PREVALENCE_RATE > 0.1 ORDER BY a.distance;

WITH
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)') AS ref_vec_0,
    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'Bronchitis') AS ref_vec_1,

conditions_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(DESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM conditions

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

e_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(REASONDESCRIPTION_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM encounters

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
),

AcuteBronchitisConditions AS (
    SELECT PATIENT, START, STOP, ENCOUNTER
      FROM conditions_filtered AS conditions
),

BronchitisEncounters AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.DATE, e.PATIENT, e.DESCRIPTION, e.REASONDESCRIPTION, e.distance
      FROM e_filtered AS e
      JOIN AcuteBronchitisConditions abc ON toString(e.PATIENT) = toString(abc.PATIENT)
      ORDER BY e.distance
      LIMIT 10
)

SELECT ap.PREVALENCE_RATE
FROM all_prevalences ap
JOIN BronchitisEncounters be ON toString(ap.ITEM) = toString(be.REASONDESCRIPTION)
WHERE ap.POPULATION_TYPE = 'General'
LIMIT 1;

    LIMIT 10

      FROM e_filtered AS e
)

FROM m_filtered AS m
JOIN EncounterMatch em ON toString(m.PATIENT) = toString(em.PATIENT)
ORDER BY m.distance
LIMIT 5;
